After some feedback

We went ahead and changed the 3rd person back to First. 
Worked on some animation montages.
Added back in the original start level to the second level.

Gabby is now in the game, talks, crawls, runs around.

Added in some more voice acting as well. 

Did a lot guys, you really need to play it, I really need feedback on it. This is a hell of an improvement. I actually enjoy playing it now.

notes.title: Reaching Out to the Community.
notes.content:
Hello all! There are going to be some big changes, and not just to the game. Firstly, I am having someone write out my announcements and updates, to avoid any confusion with grammar.

Secondly, I am planning to lower Time Ramesside's pricing to just 99cents, if Steam accepts my price-change form. Even if they don't, I will keep emailing them and work to lower the game's price to a reasonable level, like many have requested. I won't give up!

Thirdly, I need everyone in the community, and even outside of it, to let me know the biggest bugs and complaints they have. This is important, because I really want to make Time Ramesside as good as possible. We will even write down your complaints and address the most common ones first! If we're having trouble with a particular problem, we'll let you know, and we'll answer your questions as soon as possible.

I know Time Ramesside has gotten a lot of negative attention, and I know it isn't perfect by a long shot, but I really want to turn things around! Your criticism and support is the best way to help. Thank you for believing in me! I won't give up!


In Summary:

1. My announcements should be clearer now, and I will do my best to answer questions.

2. Time Ramesside should soon be only 99cents.

3. We need all of your feedback, we will take it seriously!

notes.title: Time Ramesside (A Misunderstood game)
notes.content:
This comment right here is pinned in the threads. I think everyone looking to buy this game should read this. This person describes what I went through perfectly, and also makes note what the game is. notes.title: Shift in Gears
notes.content:
Hi: Fans Gamers and People interested in the project,

I wanted to let you know there has been a shift in gears on the project with this being a formal annoucement to it.

The game is not going as we would've liked and we are going dark for the next couple of months. We will be focusing on improving the level design, knocking out bugs, a new and improved hud, animations and much more. 

We are listening to you, our fans and critics, so we can deliver an amazing gaming experience. 

As a result of long talks, there has been a shift in leadership with Jason no longer being the head of the project. I have been with the project for the past 3 years now and have taken this responsibility in his place. I ask for patience, positive input and constructive opinions so we can make a great game. We are not game developers without you, our fans. I for one do not deny your presence and need to be heard. 

Early access is a bold platform with varing opinions. I ask, if you can, to treat us as an individual studio. Not for favortism but because every studio operates differently with different resources, strengths and challenges. Just like every person is individual to another, our true challenge for us is to be working and tangoing with you. You all need to have the bang in your buck and have a great time with our product. No one wants to create a crappy game like no one drinks a bad long island ice tea.

The team is not able to work full time on this project as we have all full time jobs and lives we must fulfill in order to pay the bills. We are going to take a much more methodical and slower development pace under my leadership.

Our goals while we go dark as follows:

1. Improved and Adjusted balancing to gameplay.
2. More and Further developed Obelisk Totems that provide players to purchase spells and control the unending spawns of undead.
3. A very balanced boss fight with the Archdead Scorne.
4. An improved HUD that is more organized and designed specifically for FPS. We hope this streamlines the FPS gaming experience and keeps the player focused on the field and not the HUD.
5. 2 Very Polished Zones from the beginning of the game. Once you all are happy with the progression, we will be releasing story content. Gameplay has to come first.

I will be making weekly annoucements and further changes when time permits me to do so.

Again, thank you the fans for all of your input. We are no one without you and I would not have it any other way. We encourage Let's Plays and other forms media to promote our game from your experience and perspective. We only ask for fairness as we want the game to get better. It takes two to tango, so let us all tango together and celebrate this gaming experience as equals and not fear driven egos. Were all gamers here after all!

Have a wonderful near year full of positivity my fans and critics alike!

notes.title: ITS FINALY HERE UPDATE 19.0 YOU NEED TO READ THIS
notes.content:
HELLO EVERYONE!

First off I would like to thank everyones patience for not having updates the past 2 months every day.  Let me tell you it was worth it. So the following is a list of what has been updated and fixed and added. Also we are aware the continue button does not work, but the save system seems to work well. 

Also one more note we have teamed up with a Studio from China who will be handling all are animations! This includes the 8 new weapons that are in game right now with newly modeled arms and all animations for the weapons that will be delivered by the 24th of this month. So keep in mind the weapons are in game but the animations are being worked on. Also we will be contracting them out to do a lot more animations on the zombies themselves including but not limited to the new characters that are not in game, and most of all the BIG boss fights.

What we have added!
8 New weapons
1 new character
improved A.I a hair more
New Menu
New Main Menu
New Spell Menu
New textures on every menu
Opening credits movie
A actual save system
Optimization at its best ( Getting 60fps on Epic settings)
1920 resolution
Level Up system

New complete level design ( yes and I do mean new and complete) not basic levels anymore

Revamped Mark into a more badass character 
U.I work
Chat system
The key P now picks up weapons not E
a loading screen!
floating objects
and so much more.

This is not the same game anymore gamers.

A full RPG style leveling up system ( this will be explained in the next few days how to use it)  So with the spell system just like in Watch Dogs or any other game of that sort you gain XP you get skill points. Same thing here. You can purchase new spells, and also power them up. For example you got a health spell, but each time you use the spell you only gain 10 percent life well upgrade that spell and gain 15 percent life. So that kind of gives you an idea. Again this is all based on XP. 

Each Weapon which we are working on gives you more or less XP. Basically your knife is going to give you the most XP. Your biggest weapons will not.

Temp music is in game this will be taken out shortly in no way shape or forum do we own the rights.

notes.title: 13.0 New build is up
notes.content:
Hello and finally we have a new build up of the game. You can expect a few builds a week from this point on while I myself get more settled in here in Florida. I do apologize the move here has been somewhat of some minor set backs.

So lets talk about the new build

9 New spells are in game. At this time some work some do not, but they will all work by the end of the week.

Biggest news zombies will attack from behind, on the side, and keep coming at you. Good luck surviving from this point on your going to have to become a fast expert in your spell RPG system from this point on. Especially if you want to actually pass the first few levels your going to need to learn how to teleport.

We have a melee system in game now. 

We also have 7 new weapons

Now the melee system and the weapons will not be in game for about another week. Even though the system is ready we want to do some more testing.

The teleporting spell now works. Your going to need it and learn how to use it.

The first level we have made into a tutorial level to show you how to use the RPG system. 

Another new spell is the healing spell. This comes very handy.

The biggest thing I think is the A.I we now have spawn points in game and are working on some final tweaks with this system. Some things have already been changed. But yes we do have now that is not in this build a spawn counter. Meaning if we only want ten zombies to spawn from this location only ten will spawn. You will see what I mean when you play the game.

Also tweaked out the spider in the first level a bit. Got rid of the annoying NPC talking to you in the very beginning with that terrible voice. Improved the level design a little bit more. 

Alot of work was done here guys and I mean a lot of work. Way more to come. Enjoy.

notes.title: Whats going on with development right now!!!!!! MUST READ
notes.content:
Hey Gamers,

Ok so I have just hired 4 more guys.

What this means is right now I have hired

3 programmers
1 modeler

So whats being done?

Melee weapons system
This will include handguns and other weapons. He is doing it all. The basic set up is only going to take a few days than within a few hours after that point when a new weapon with the animations is finished we can get it in game.

A.I - I have someone working on the kinks with A.I responds to sound, eye sight, calls other zombies, feeds off dead bodies when low on health, respond to being shot and much more.

Play mechanics, my other programmer is working on a hit detection system. Head shots will now be in game along with an auto targeting system that will slow down time for a few seconds, I don't want to give to many details away on this but I think you guys know where that is going. 

Multiplayer. I have found another guy that am working out the details with that is going to intergrate steam into the game and get the game running on multi. This am not sure how long is going to take but I will keep you updated. Since he really knows his stuff am guessing a week maybe 2 at max. Again I am not sure.

Also one of the programmers can do the hud. However am getting all these things out of the way and a few more than will work on the hud. Get the magic meter in game (middle mouse button) for the players power, and get that set up properly.

Animations are still being worked on for zhern and ther other zombies. 

Wave points will also be added. We are not sure what direction to take this but will figure out something here very shortly, we are trying a few things.

notes.title: NEW BUILD 6.1 You all want better A.I right!?!?!
notes.content:
NEWS on 4.3 UE4!!

This is big news as well. UE4 will know support crowds. Meaning no more zombies falling in the same path. We also hope this new build will correct gamma control and a few more items.

We will also be launching on
Mac
Linux
64 bit support.

We assure you the a.i will improve by ten times with 4.3 coming out soon. How soon great question! Wish we had an answer. 4.3 preview is out right now and we are currently testing with it. However it is a preview. So as soon as the full verison is released will work hard on getting that in game. 


Ok so we noticed some pretty big bugs today from yesterdays build.

One being a wall that you could walk through. This seemed to cause some issues. That is now fixed.

We have lowered down the spiders health from 1500 to 1000. This seems to be working a lot better.

Another major bug was we where missing a floor so you couldn't get to the next level. That is now fixed

I sped up the zombies animations. Some still will glide without the animations taking place.

Today I made all the levels work together, and took out one real bad level. The level was old and didn't make a lot of sense. Now all the levels work out really well. The first level that no one new where to go is now in the middle of the game. We took level 3 and blended it into that specific level. So you now actually walk out of the prison into terrain, where you can go exploring.

All the levels now flow with proper textures in place, not just randomized stuff going on anymore.

We added 3 clips to each pickup of weapons.
We have also fixed lighting being reported where lights are being shown but no  static mesh is there with an actual light. This works the same way where static mesh lights where there was no lighting. That should be all fixed now.

We have also added ARROWS to show you how to get to the next part of the game.

I spent half the day working on getting a wavepoint system in and UE4 is not quite there yet to do what we want it to do.

New Build will be coming out in less than 2 hours.

notes.content:
New Build 5.1
Hey guys.

This is what is fixed and improved.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TGjiadYW024&feature=youtu.be

If you watched the video a lot different huh guys. If we did progress like this every day which we do you just don't see some major changes like this in a days work, imagine what it will be like in a week. Imagine in a month. I was not joking when we said we make leaps and bounds of progress!

Level 1 has had a huge make over. 
Bluebox weapon pickups now in game
a generic temp controller description is in place
Improved the zombies a.i. - Zombies now hit you
Put back in players power - middle mouse button
Fixed some holes in level 3
Took out gabby for the time being
Changed the first cutscene
Player now has to explore in the first level
More enemies are in the first level
fixed some collision issues
fixed floating mesh issues in the first level
fixed lightiing throughout the game
Fixed nav paths in level 3
fixed nav paths in level 5
Fixed city. We had the wrong city loaded we apologize. Knock yourselves out with that.
Fixed some animations with the zombies
Took out exploding zombies in some areas. Waiting for feedback on this if you guys think there is still to many explosions going on.
Level 1 should be sealed up now pretty tight.
Level 3 should be sealed up pretty tight.
Took out more UE4 assets as requested. 

However during this process the mowhawk zombies are stuck in t-pose. Am sure this is a simple compliing error and will be fixed tomorrow. Along with the Horde modes weapons back in game. Also the rest of the first level will be finished tomorrow as well, along with primarly focusing on the hud, and fixing the rest of the a.i

Also the hud we are currently working on. That is something that is going to take awhile. Same with the character arms. UE4 is very buggy and a lot of things are still broken in the game engine, but epic is working very hard on this.

New build should be up in about 2 hours. It is packaging right now.

We appreciate it Jim if you could keep doing videos! Your critiquing is some of the best and video is the best to show off bugs, and other things!
